name: Dark Mending cuts half a second off Sanguine Mend (#1088)
contract: Dark Mending 561278 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -501 + DieSides 1 = -500 ms, over EffectSpellClassMask (524288, 0, 0) = word 0 bit 19 = the nine Sanguine Mend records (504079-504086, 802310). Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME. Tooltip: "Reduces the cast time of Sanguine Mend by $/1000;S1 sec." That Description is the whole of what this issue reports; 561278's separate AuraDescription names an unrelated, unreachable mechanic (504563, triggered only by the record literally named "Placeholder"), which is out of scope here. Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Sanguine Mend keeps its authored cast time before the talent
